title: Dungeon entrance keep on the far snow-side edge, grounded and facing inland, with the entrance shaft
player_outcome: Near the snow-side coast stands a tall brick keep with corner turrets and crenellations, the Old Man waiting at its arched door facing inland. Inside, a pillared foyer opens onto a platformed shaft down into the dungeon.
design: Keep: interior 20×16×20. Walls 3 cells (a 2 brick shell plus an inner panel). Crenellated parapet. Four corner turrets as Cylinder ops (r 3, 24 tall) with stepped caps. A front facade 2 cells thicker.
Door: an arched doorway 6 wide × 9 tall (stepped arch carve at +9..+10) facing Inward, and two slit windows.
Foundation: fill brick from min(surface under the footprint) − 6 up to the keep floor, so the keep never floats.
Approach: NoZone carve 10 wide × 12 tall × 12 deep in front of the door, and NoZone brick steps up to the door if the door floor is above the terrain.
Foyer: 4 pillars and a central 10×10 floor opening into the entrance shaft down to the planner's trunk start, with platforms every 4 cells.
Landmark dungeon_gate: the ground cell 3 cells outside the door. The Old Man stays outside the zone thanks to NoZone.
DungeonTests.CryptWallsResistPicksUntilTheWardenFalls picks a wall cell from Layout.KeepInterior instead of gate offsets.
Re-pin golden hashes (no further GenVersion bump within P4).
files_add: src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Structures/DungeonBuilder.Keep.cs — keep, turrets, foundation, approach, foyer, shaft
tests: DungeonGenerationTests.TheKeepStandsOnTheGround: no air under the foundation footprint.
DungeonTests.ZonesFollow… still: ZonesAt(dungeon_gate) has no dungeon.
Smoke dungeon.cmds keeps 'tp landmark dungeon_gate', 'wait_until town.old_man == 1 60', 'assert zone.dungeon == 0'.
verification: lavapipe screenshot of the facade at noon (screenshot tour stop, see P4-23)
risks: On mountainous snow terrain the foundation can be very deep. Cap it at 24 cells and otherwise flatten with a stepped plinth.
A turret may intersect a tree placed by the ecology pass. Tree cells are overwritten by Fill, which is acceptable.
